newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Kia to split sales division.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Kia to split sales division.

text.p: South Korea's Kia Motors Corp said on Thursday it would split its sales division into a separate company in April or May to strengthen its domestic marketing effort.
"The new company will be responsible for car sales and after-sales service. It will help Kia Motors focus on production and research," said Min Jae-ki, a Kia spokesman.
Kia said it was considering absorbing Kia Service Co Ltd, which now provides after-sales service, into the new company.
Min said the move was aimed at increasing efficiency by integrating marketing and service functions.
"We need to strengthen our marketing capability, which compares unfavourably with that of our rivals Hyundai Motor and Daewoo Motor," said another spokesman.
Kia said Kia Motors would continue to export vehicles.
The new sales company will also branch out into other business areas, including distribution.
The second spokesman refused to give further details.
